# Western Heating & Cooling

> Western Heating & Cooling delivers premium residential and multifamily HVAC installations, diagnostics, repairs, and PG&E rebate energy upgrades throughout Pleasanton, CA and California's Central Valley.

## Services
- New Central AC & Heating Installations: Complete residential and commercial system design, replacement, and Title 24 compliant installations.
- Seasonal Maintenance & Pre-Season Check-Ups: Multi-point inspections, coil cleanings, and safety verifications before summer and winter peaks.
- Repair & Diagnostic Service: Precision electrical, mechanical, and refrigerant troubleshooting with upfront, transparent pricing.
- Blower Fan Motor Upgrades (Concept 3™ / Western Cooling Control™): Proprietary fan motor efficiency enhancements to cut kilowatt-hour cooling consumption.
- PG&E CHRP — Comfortable Home Rebates: Authorized contractor services capturing state and local rebates for energy-saving HVAC upgrades.
- PG&E MFCO — Multifamily HVAC Upgrade Program: Turnkey heating and cooling retrofits and rebate fulfillment for multifamily properties.

## Service Areas
- Pleasanton, CA
- Dublin, CA
- Livermore, CA
- San Ramon, CA
- California's Central Valley
- Western United States
